snippet.title: Sneaky Clean - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Sneaky Clean is a co-op cleaning game where not everyone is squeaky clean.
Scrub down a luxury resort and clean up after the ones playing dirty. Play solo or in co-op, with or without troublemakers and prove you're not all washed up !

Wishlist now ! : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4360140/Sneaky_Clean/
